interpretation: This adds fresh exact-CCN CMS enrollment and current NPPES data, plus the applicable CMS v3 field definition. The file's 1900 value is therefore a material publisher-metadata conflict, not an alternate address we can normalize away. Do not edit its bytes or silently change the tracker; keep the CCN unresolved pending publisher correction/explanation or an authoritative current licensing record that locates this hospital at 1900.
